gates: no label read before the committed registration and its verified public receipt (nrm.common.registered)
'fit' and 'calibrate' reads need a committed, unchanged mechanism card under results/<campaign>/cards/ (path, SHA-256 and commit logged with the read)
MODEL_SELECT labels are never read by a fitting entry point (nrm.fa, nrm.fb, nrm.fc, nrm.ctl)
entry points can be added only by a dated, committed ACCESS_AMENDMENTS.json entry before first use
log: .private/<campaign>/access/LABEL_ACCESS.jsonl (append-only; utc, unit id, entry point, role, fields, operation, purpose, people, households, row-set hash, card)

benchmark.what: original-benchmark utility (24 clauses + 4 guards), the development reserve and paired utility costs of saved releases (logged adaptive selection and diagnosis; never a fitting input)

calibrate.what: calibration parameters only (CALIBRATION has no SEX label)

fit.what: fitting release parameters of a family, its task-only twin or a control on the full MODEL_FIT pool (household-grouped internal folds for any cross-fitting); SEX only as a training label of a protection objective or critic

readers.what: fresh development reader grid (FIT / VALIDATION / SCORE reader roles inside MODEL_SELECT)

screen.what: development screening readers on the registered screening split of MODEL_SELECT (adaptive diagnosis only)

verify.what: independent verifier replay with separate metric, selection and reader code
